title: `REPEAT` with a count past INT raises under ANSI
verdict: raises where the reference gives a value
description: `REPEAT(s, n)` takes an INT count: under ANSI a BIGINT count past 2³¹ − 1 raises `CAST_OVERFLOW`, even for `''`, which the reference repeats into `''`; without ANSI it gives `''`. A count of 0 gives `''`.
reference: `BinFn.strRepeat`: `s` repeated `n` times, `''` for `n ≤ 0`; an error only past `Text.repeatMax` bytes.

provenance.notes: `sverify_dev.probe_spark`'s `_writer_probes`, run locally with ANSI on and off, on the folded and the codegen path, which agree on each. pyspark 4.3.0, Java 21.0.13, macOS arm64, session time zone UTC (BASE_CONF); probes.json's header records the earlier homelab run.
